conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: My debit card’s not working online! I keep getting ‘transaction failed.’ Fix it!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the issue Sir. Can you confirm if you’ve enabled online transactions for your card?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Enabled? I thought it’s automatic. Nobody told me about this!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: No worries. You can enable it via the app or I can do it for you. Shall I proceed?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Yeah, do it now. I’m in a hurry!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It’s done Sir. Your card is now enabled for online use. Try again in a few minutes.
